subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: gap closure plan, retention change, and capacity top-up
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@maplebank.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@maplebank.com>, Matt Reynolds <matt.reynolds@maplebank.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 renewal — retention window change & short notice capacity increase

Hi Karthik,

As we discussed in last week's renewal call, MapleBank is moving our audit window from 12 months to 18 months for the upcoming cycle. We need to understand downstream impacts for log retention and whether you can support the extended window in your hosted environment. Separately, our fraud team has asked for a short-notice throughput increase for Q3 during a marketing spike — roughly a 40% seat/capacity bump for 6 weeks.

Can you confirm: 
- Are there any evidence gaps we should be aware of for the 18-month retention change?
- Can you provide a runbook for the evidence transfer and an estimate for the retention storage delta?
- Is the 40% temporary capacity top-up feasible under our current terms, and if not, how long to onboard Dedicated or burst capacity?

We have a SOC 2 review scheduled with our external auditors on Aug 12, so timing is tight. I'll loop procurement once we have a proposed cost amendment.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Soto
Head of Compliance, MapleBank
elena.soto@maplebank.com
+1 415-555-0123

(Attachment: initial-log-mapping.csv)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@maplebank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal — retention window change & short notice capacity increase

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. Quick summary up front: we can support 18-month retention and the temporary 40% capacity top-up, but there are three things to coordinate before your Aug 12 audit: evidence packaging, a short-term capacity amendment, and a runbook for log transfer/validation.

Im attaching a focused "SOC2 evidence checklist" (spreadsheet) and a retention-impact CSV that estimates storage delta for common log volumes. High-level notes:
- Evidence gaps: none that block an 18mo window, but we will need a slightly expanded sampling set for the attestation (we call it the 18mo sample matrix). Ive put the sample requirements in tab 2 of the checklist.
- Evidence transfer: we prefer SFTP or a secure Drive link for bulk artifacts; we will validate hashes and return an ingestion receipt within 24 hours of upload.
- Capacity top-up: we can enable burst capacity from Dedicated pools within 48 hours of a signed amendment; if you want it done under hosted terms we can offer a temporary overage rate but it requires a 7-day runway to ensure autoscaling policies and cache warmup are configured.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ill share the checklist and an editable contract amendment draft.
2) Schedule a 30-min handoff with our security engineer (Jonas) and your audit lead to walk the evidence matrix (we have availability tomorrow afternoon).
3) If Procurement is ready, well get a signature on the amendment to enable burst capacity; otherwise we can provision a 7-day-notice overage window.

Proposed meeting times: Fri 2pm PT or Mon 10am PT. Which works for you?

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
(Attachment: soc2_evidence_checklist.xlsx; log-retention-matrix.csv)

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@maplebank.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@maplebank.com>, Matt Reynolds <matt.reynolds@maplebank.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal — retention window change & short notice capacity increase

Thanks Karthik — that all sounds reasonable. Matt (cc) is our infra lead; hell join the handoff. Friday 2pm PT works for us.

Two quick clarifications before the call: 
- Can you ballpark the incremental monthly storage cost for a ~5TB log increase?
- For the amendment, wed prefer a one-time signed addendum rather than changing baseline hosted terms if possible. Procurement will review pricing and route for signature.

Ill upload the initial exported logs to the Drive folder you shared and invite Jonas and Laura.

Best,
Elena

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@maplebank.com>, Procurement <procurement@maplebank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Legal <legal@redwood.com>, Finance <finance@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2027 17:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: attestation gap closure plan, amendment draft, and provisioning timeline

Team — follow-up from our handoff (great session today). Confirming actions and timelines so procurement has everything for review: 

1) Evidence / retention: Redwood will accept the 18-month retention artifacts. Jon as security engineer will run a validation pass against the uploaded bundle and provide the 18mo sample matrix by EOD Jul 12.

2) Amendment / pricing: Attached is a short addendum (contract-amendment-draft.docx) that: 
   - Adds an 18-month retention SLA for attestation purposes (no change to baseline data residency controls) 
   - Defines a temporary capacity top-up option: either a 6-week Dedicated burst (provisioned within 48 hours of signed addendum) OR a hosted overage at 1.6x baseline rate with 7 days notice.
   - Includes a not-to-exceed storage uplift estimate for 5TB (see log-retention-matrix.csv) — procurement can select a fixed monthly uplift or true-up post-period.

3) Provisioning: Once the addendum is signed: 
   - If Dedicated burst selected: we provision and test in 48 hours; production traffic switch can occur after a 6-hour warmup.
   - If hosted overage selected: enable autoscaling policy and billing flags; 7-day lead time required.

Legal/Finance — please review the attached addendum and confirm if youd like a fixed uplift or a true-up billing model.

Elena/Matt — next milestone is the evidence validation report from Jonas by Jul 12 and your procurement sign-off on Jul 15 to meet the Aug 12 audit.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
(Attachments: contract-amendment-draft.docx)
